title: HTTP Server
concept: Build HTTP servers with xiom.http — handle routes, parse requests, serve responses, and create REST APIs with middleware support.
why: Servers are the most common backend application. From microservices to full APIs, HTTP servers are the foundation of networked software.
tips: Use middleware for cross-cutting concerns — logging, auth, CORS, rate limiting
Route parameters (:id) make URLs clean and RESTful — parse and validate them
Always set Content-Type on JSON responses — clients depend on it
Graceful shutdown: handle SIGTERM to finish in-flight requests before stopping
common_mistakes: Not validating request bodies — always parse and validate before using
Blocking the server thread with long operations — use async or offload to worker threads
Returning 200 for errors — use appropriate status codes (404, 400, 500)
